Never merge AI output without review.

An AI agent can edit your code.

Watch the loop that keeps you in charge.

You prompt with context.

The agent proposes an edit in the sandbox,

tests run, you review the diff, then merge.

Inside the sandbox the agent edits and runs tests without asking.

To touch the network or other folders, it stops and asks.

Before you merge, read the diff and check the tests.

Merge only when both are good.

Skip the loop and the agent's mistake ships.

Run the loop, and you catch it before it reaches your branch.
